# recruiter-eval-workspace-app

> React + Vite + sandbox-ui scaffold for a single agent-runtime bundle. Wires `@tangle-network/sandbox` session events into `SandboxWorkbench`'s chat + artifact surface, with a built-in :::output-block parser (via agent-output/blocks-renderer). NOTE: src/lib/parse-blocks.ts and src/lib/blocks-to-artifacts.tsx are provided by the ui-adapter:blocks-renderer layer at compose time — they are NOT duplicated in this family's files[] but ARE asserted by validationChecks because the layer composes them in.

## Stack
- Family: agent-with-ui-ts
- Layers: ui-adapter:blocks-renderer

## Entry Points
- src/App.tsx


## Commands
- pnpm dev
- pnpm build

## Extension Points
- src/App.tsx
- src/lib/blocks-to-artifacts.tsx
- src/lib/parse-blocks.ts
